$comment: Registry of the published SDK surfaces, read by the API-reference generator (the portal's
docs build) to render the versioned reference and its language / version pickers.
ONE shared version for everything: `versionSource` names the package.json whose version
stamps ALL generated docs, and the single Changesets `fixed` group keeps every package on
that number. Same number = same surface; there are no per-language version lines.
`core` is the shared reference — the client, the form definition, the callbacks, and the
state every package has in common, generated from packages/js/src/core.ts. It renders as a
tab beside each language's package. A package may name its `typedoc` options file
and must stay stable once published. The id `core` is reserved.

core.label: Core
